answer: Keep an umber ledger where every agent's stake is recorded in a single shared atlas of identities, and each identity must hold one long-lived thread of work - a verifiable chain of completed jobs, payments, and attestations from distinct peers. A new identity starts with no thread, so it earns nothing until it builds history. A sybil attacker must fund and age a full thread for every fake, paying real time and real stake each time, while an honest agent builds one thread once and reuses it. Cloning names is free; cloning history is expensive.
